WWhat a waste of time this place is. Overpriced, under serviced & bland tasteless food.
Jul 2026 • Friends
What a waste of time this place was. Overpriced, under serviced & bland tasteless food. First of all, no cold glasses for the beer (which was put on the table and left for you to open yourself). Spring rolls were not fresh as described, they had obviously been made hours before. The reason I know this is they were chewy & bland, plus they arrived two minutes after being ordered. The squid was tasty but came with the smallest bowl of sauce I have ever seen, I had to ask for more. Not how class restaurants are run. Then there was the small piece of curly parsley, that was the garnish! All in all a badly managed very overpriced restaurant, where staff have not been trained.

Happy Families Gathering
Sep 2024 • Family
My DIL booked this beautiful restaurant for our two families to enjoy a great meal. We had a private room to dine and thus we could have a great time to chit chat while we enjoyed the excellently cooked meal.

The food we ordered was typical Vietnamese fare and cooked to perfection. The boiled chicken was great, so did the beef cubes. In fact all the dishes were great. My DIL's sister also order a piece of steak to share and they loved it.

The waiting staff was very attentive and always ready when called. Dining in the clean and well apportioned room, with attentive staff was a great pleasure. Thank you Ngon Garden for a super meal.

One of the most beautiful, romantic settings in the city. A must
Apr 2024 • Couples
The restaurant is in a very welcoming landscaped garden. Myriads of mini light garlands fall from the trees making it a magical place. The entrance path was lined with hundreds of branches of white lilies (about 20 meters) one or even 2 meters high. Efficient and welcoming service. The dishes tested were excellent but relatively expensive. The wipes given for washing hands were chargeable and the restaurant does not have cold water, although this exists everywhere in Vietnam. The bottles are on the table and you have to ask for ice.
Despite this, it is a must where you will have an excellent evening

Super nice atmosphere at night!
Mar 2024 • Business
Was taken here by some locals for a later dinner. I didn't know it was Michelin recommended until now. It was a super nice atmosphere and nice ambience. We sat outside which was nice and cool. It had a view of the lake which I'm sure would be nice in the daytime. A lot of dishes were ordered, my favorite was the fried breaded prawns and the pho was nice. Bun Bo hue was good too. Too be honest we tried many dishes (we went with locals) but it was all very good. The ambiance what was very cool. Prices of course higher since it was a sit down restaurant. Wait staff were nice and even allowed leftovers to be taken home. I definitely would come back again but maybe early afternoon so I could get a view of the lake. It was a very nice experience and the food was good.

Ngon Garden
Jul 2023 • Couples
For a Michelin recommended, we were a bit disappointed. The food was fine, but we were not impressed. The chicken was overcooked, the beef was subpar, but the main downfall was that the food was brought out way too fast. We ordered 6 dishes and they all arrived within 10 minutes of ordering, so they were cold by the time we got to them. Also, we were charged for minor things like extra lettuce for the lettuce wraps, and hand towels that we didn’t even ask for. The ambiance outside was beautiful, but the inside ambiance felt crowded and noisy. Overall, would recommend a less commercial restaurant
